title: Quick anxiety check-in (GAD-2)
description: A 2-question screen for generalized anxiety over the past 2 weeks. A positive screen escalates to the full GAD-7. Pre-operative anxiety is a known predictor of worse postoperative recovery.

items.text: Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by feeling nervous, anxious, or on edge?
Over the last 2 weeks, how often have you been bothered by not being able to stop or control worrying?

thresholds.message: Positive anxiety screen (GAD-2 ≥3). Recommend escalation to GAD-7 and clinician follow-up.

citation: Kroenke K, Spitzer RL, Williams JBW, Monahan PO, Löwe B. Anxiety disorders in primary care: prevalence, impairment, comorbidity, and detection. Ann Intern Med 2007;146:317-25. PMID: 17339617
